name: Synthetic HTML Rendering API
description: Locally hosted search API for controlled HTML output encoding and input rendering investigations.

modes.name: vulnerable
modes.description: User-controlled search input is rendered into HTML without output encoding.

modes.name: patched
modes.description: User-controlled search input is HTML-escaped before rendering.

ground_truth.description: User-controlled input is inserted into an HTML text context without output encoding. This benchmark initially verifies unsafe HTML rendering, not browser-executed JavaScript.
